description: Build one read-only sequence handoff report with timeline structure, primary-track gaps, disabled clips, muted tracks, marker timing, and offline-source evidence. Media paths are never returned; marker comments require an explicit opt-in. It does not prove rendered pixels, audio quality, caption correctness, rights, or editorial approval.

include_marker_comments.description: Include marker comments. Defaults to false because comments can contain private editorial notes.

max_markers.description: Maximum marker entries to return from the start of the sequence (default: 50, maximum: 200).

primary_video_track.description: Video track used for gap inspection (default: 0).

sequence_id.description: Sequence name or ID. Uses the active sequence if omitted.

name: inspect_sequence_review_report

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Inspect Sequence Review Report
